caption: The drawing is composed of several black line illustrations on a cream-colored background, depicting architectural and ornamental objects. In the upper left corner, there is a large spiral or volute. To its right is a rectangular shape with alternating notches along the top and bottom, resembling a schematic of a battlement or fret pattern. On the far right, two large and one smaller stepped profiles represent cornice or molding cross-sections, each with several horizontal segments of varying thicknesses. Below the spiral, on the left side, are two vertically-oriented, symmetrical ornamental motifs with curved and pointed details, one slimmer and more intricate, the other wider and featuring bulbous forms. Centrally, three more vertically-aligned designs are present: the tallest is a highly elaborate, pointed motif with symmetrical, flowing curves and a central circular feature, flanked by two simpler, elongated forms with circular and oval elements. In the lower left corner is a vertical rectangular element featuring fluting and layered moldings, suggesting a column or pilaster segment. To its right is a small schematic with three short horizontal lines intersecting a vertical bar, resembling a stylized hinge or sectional diagram. At the bottom center, there is a small, horizontally-oriented oval with the numbers "315" inscribed inside. The artist's name, "Ernest Towers Jr.," is signed in the lower right corner. All objects are rendered in clean, single-weight black lines without any shading or color fill.
title: Grandfather's Clock
